schemaNote: Machine-readable source of truth for branch and path ownership during the 24-hour Detective Track build. Read by ops/scripts/check-ownership.mjs and .github/workflows/*. If this file and any prose document disagree, this file wins.

docsConfigBranches.description: Documentation and repository-configuration branches. These may not touch product code at all.
docsConfigBranches.note: chore/game-contracts is exempt from this rule and is governed by the contractsOnly entry below.

contractsOnly.description: Creates the shared interface files every other agent imports. Must merge before implementation branches open PRs. Types and interfaces only — no runtime logic, no React components.
contractsOnly.hour15CutNote: Never cut. Everything depends on it.

agents.summary: Game state, flags, autosave, city routes, and the integration glue that hosts panels.
agents.forbiddenPathsNote: These two are shared contracts owned by chore/game-contracts. Import them; do not edit them. Needed changes go through the release captain.

additional: Reload restores location, flags, evidence and case board.
load() returns null on a corrupt save and never throws.

agents.hour15CutNote: Never cut. Every other branch depends on state and routes.

agents.summary: World map, panels, hotspots, panel shell and transitions.
agents.forbiddenPathsNote: world/types.ts is a shared contract owned by chore/game-contracts.

additional: Panels render with procedural T0 art and no commissioned assets.
Hotspots are reachable by keyboard and by pointer.

agents.hour15CutNote: Cut from five panels to three (office, victim-flat, bank-branch) before cutting anything else here.

agents.summary: Pressure and timing, the AI adapter and hints, lawful recovery workflows, and the case debrief. Holds the only approval to make additive changes to existing product code.
agents.forbiddenPathsNote: adapter.ts is a shared contract owned by chore/game-contracts. Implementations live beside it, not inside it.
agents.additiveOnlyNote: Additive changes only: new optional props, new exports, appended Zod schemas. No refactors, no signature changes, no reformatting. schemas.ts is append-only. use-live-call.ts was granted by the release captain for ONE purpose: an optional onComplete(score) callback, invoked where the score is already produced. Nothing else in that file may change.

additional: Every case completes with GEMINI_API_KEY unset and the network offline.
Case outcome is identical with AI on and AI off.

agents.hour15CutNote: The timed decision becomes untimed before the recovery path is cut. Recovery is a brief requirement — failure must never dead-end.

agents.summary: Dialogue engine and box, case board, evidence cards, inventory and deterministic verification.
agents.forbiddenPathsNote: Both are shared contracts owned by chore/game-contracts.

additional: The dialogue engine is a pure reducer and is unit tested.
A choice gated on a discovered fact is hidden until that fact is held.

agents.hour15CutNote: The case board is the deduction surface. Cut visual polish, never the board.

agents.summary: All data for the case 'The Ten-Minute Window'. Data only — no engine code, no components.

additional: Every dialogue node is reachable and every ending attainable.
At least 3 evidence items, 2 plausible false leads, 1 fact-gated choice.
All organisations, numbers and identities are fictional.

agents.hour15CutNote: Cut the victim perspective content first; the detective case reads flags that default to 'the victim complied'.

agents.summary: Joins the five merged silos into a playable game: real registry, rendered world and dialogue UI, the authored case fed in, debrief, pressure, the victim's live call, and an entry point.
agents.note: Created after the five build agents merged. Their branches are closed, so the overlapping paths below have a single live owner: this one.
agents.forbiddenPathsNote: Shared contracts. Import them; never edit them.
agents.additiveOnlyNote: CallRoom and use-live-call: new optional props and the onComplete callback only. registry.ts and the case content: id corrections and the npc-to-node map only, never a rewrite of another agent's authored work.
agents.dependsOnNote: All five build branches are merged. Nothing blocks this.

additional: A test fails if any hotspot references an unknown evidence or npc id.
Map to panel to dialogue to evidence to case board to debrief completes end to end.
The case completes with GEMINI_API_KEY unset and the network offline.
Reload mid-case restores location, flags, evidence and board.
A failure path routes into recovery and does not dead-end.

agents.hour15CutNote: Never cut. Without this there is no playable game, only five unreachable libraries.

release.role: Integration and merge authority. The only role that merges to main.
responsibilities: Merge chore/game-contracts first and announce it.
Enforce merge order: contracts, then foundation, then world-ui and detective-ui, then simulation-recovery, then content.
Resolve every cross-branch conflict. Agents never resolve another agent's conflict.
Own the hour-15 scope-cut decision and announce it on the coordination board.
Cut release/demo and verify the deploy.
Apply the manual GitHub settings in docs/REPO-SETUP.md before agents start.

hour15Gate.test: map -> panel -> dialogue -> evidence -> case board is playable end to end
ifFailing: Cut the victim perspective; ship the detective case alone.
Cut five panels to three: office, victim-flat, bank-branch.
Cut panel backgrounds to typographic only.
Cut the timed decision to untimed.
hour15Gate.note: Decide at hour 15, not at hour 20.

qualityGate.lintNote: pnpm lint exists but is deliberately not part of the required gate: the repository documents a known typescript-eslint incompatibility with the TypeScript 7 alias (see README troubleshooting). Run it locally if you wish; it does not gate PRs during this sprint.
qualityGate.secretsNote: CI must never require GEMINI_API_KEY. Every test runs against mock providers and authored fallbacks.
